programs.title: Superskilled with Eva Zu Beck
programs.desc: Eva zu Beck travels to the farthest corners of the Earth to find people with amazing abilities.In the Copper Canyon in Mexico, he meets ultramarathon champions from the Rarámuri tribe.In Tanzania, she tries to survive thanks to the knowledge she acquired from the Hadzabe, while in the deep Amazon, members of the Matis tribe teach her how to navigate in the vast jungle without a map or GPS.Later, he learns the secrets of carrying heavy loads to the highest peak in Africa and one of the highest in the world from the local porters.

programs.title: Brain Games
programs.desc: The human brain, when processing huge amounts of information, makes mistakes.Scientists discuss the most common ones and show how to avoid them.

programs.title: X: The Generation That Changed the World
programs.sub_title: And there will be technological progress on Earth
programs.desc: Often called outsiders, searching for the meaning of their own existence, working from dawn to dusk, although rejecting the rat race and excessive consumerism - generationThe filmmakers will trace all the most important events that influenced the formation of representatives of this generation.Viewers will learn how the development of technology - from the pocket calculator to the birth of Google - social and political upheavals and the emergence of mass culture have changed their everyday lives.

programs.title: Alaska: The Next Generation
programs.desc: The daily struggles of people who gave up the achievements of civilization to be able to live according to their own rules.They made the risky decision to live in the wild and frosty wilderness of Alaska.

programs.title: Primal Survivor
programs.desc: American survival instructor Hazen Audel visits exotic corners of the globe and joins the tribes inhabiting them.Techniques that have been used in a given place for millennia are learned.
